rules.name: Feedback Creation Timing Constraint
rules.statement: A Feedback Record must only be created after a Delivery Proof exists for the associated Order Request.
rules.condition: When a customer attempts to submit a review for a completed order
rules.if_violated: The submission request is rejected and the customer is prompted to complete delivery first
rules.rationale: Prevents reviews based on incomplete or unverified deliveries, ensuring data integrity

parameters.name: required_delivery_proof_status
parameters.description: Status indicating delivery has been physically verified and proof uploaded

rules.name: Feedback Closure Dependency
rules.statement: A Feedback Record must not be closed if the associated Dispute Ticket is still active.
rules.condition: When a user or agent attempts to close a feedback record
exceptions: Dispute Ticket explicitly marked as resolved prior to closure attempt
rules.if_violated: The closure action is blocked and the user is notified that the dispute must be resolved first
rules.rationale: Ensures unresolved customer grievances are not hidden from the support workflow

parameters.name: active_dispute_status
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating an open dispute ticket exists for the order

rules.name: Quality Score Impact Rule
rules.statement: A Feedback Record with a negative rating regarding product quality must reduce the overall quality score of the Store Partner.
rules.condition: When a new Feedback Record is submitted for a completed task
exceptions: Feedback explicitly marked as 'not applicable' to quality
rules.if_violated: The quality score calculation is skipped for this record, potentially inflating the partner's score
rules.rationale: Ensures accurate performance tracking and fair compensation for store partners

parameters.name: quality_deduction_factor
parameters.description: Percentage or points deducted from the score per negative quality record

rules.name: Supervisor Routing Threshold
rules.statement: A Feedback Record with a rating below the defined acceptable level must be routed to a Fulfillment Supervisor for investigation.
rules.condition: Immediately after a Feedback Record is successfully submitted
exceptions: Rating falls within the acceptable threshold range
rules.if_violated: The record remains in the general queue, delaying necessary quality intervention
rules.rationale: Ensures low-rated experiences are reviewed by management to prevent recurrence

parameters.name: acceptable_rating_threshold
parameters.description: Minimum rating score required to avoid supervisor escalation

rules.name: Order Minimum Value Enforcement
rules.statement: An Order Request must not be submitted if the total calculated value of selected items is less than the minimum order value defined in the Store Partner Agreement.
exceptions: Customer applies a valid promotional coupon that covers the shortfall, if business policy allows
rules.if_violated: The Order Request is rejected with an error message indicating the minimum order value requirement
rules.rationale: To ensure economic viability of small orders and cover operational costs for the store partner

parameters.name: minimum_order_value
parameters.description: The lowest total monetary value allowed for an order

rules.name: Expiry Risk Order Rejection
rules.statement: An Order Request must not be created if it contains any item flagged as 'nearing expiry' in the primary fulfillment source.
rules.condition: during Order Request creation and validation
exceptions: Customer explicitly opts-in to purchase 'nearing expiry' items at a discounted rate, if configured
rules.if_violated: The Order Request is automatically rejected to prevent waste and quality issues
rules.rationale: To maintain product quality standards and minimize food waste from selling items close to expiration

parameters.name: expiry_threshold_days
parameters.description: The number of days remaining before an item is flagged as nearing expiry

rules.name: Stock Lock Release Timing
rules.statement: Locked stock associated with an Order Request must be automatically released if the Order Request remains unconfirmed within the allocated time window.
rules.condition: after the allocated confirmation time window expires
exceptions: Manual override by a Store Partner manager for exceptional circumstances
rules.if_violated: The stock is freed for other customers, potentially causing the original order to be fulfilled late or cancelled
rules.rationale: To prevent inventory hoarding and ensure fair access to stock for all customers

parameters.name: allocation_time_window
parameters.description: The maximum duration an Order Request can hold locked stock before auto-release

rules.name: Dispute Ticket Linkage Integrity
rules.statement: A Dispute Ticket must remain linked to the original Order Request for the entire duration of the dispute resolution process.
rules.condition: during the lifecycle of a Dispute Ticket
rules.if_violated: The Dispute Ticket becomes orphaned, preventing accurate tracking of resolution against the specific order
rules.rationale: To ensure auditability and accurate financial settlement by tying disputes to the specific transaction

parameters.name: resolution_duration
parameters.description: The expected timeframe for resolving a dispute

rules.name: Single-Order Stock Locking
rules.statement: A specific stock quantity must be locked exclusively to a single Order Request until the Fulfillment Task is completed or the Order Request is cancelled.
rules.condition: When a Fulfillment Task is created for an Order Request
rules.if_violated: The system must prevent the creation of a second Fulfillment Task for the same stock unit and flag the inventory as corrupted
rules.rationale: Prevents overselling and ensures inventory accuracy in a high-velocity environment

parameters.name: lock_duration
parameters.description: Time window during which stock is reserved

rules.name: Mandatory Quality Verification
rules.statement: A Fulfillment Task may only transition to a 'Ready for Dispatch' status if a valid quality verification record exists for every item in the task.
rules.condition: When attempting to change Fulfillment Task status to 'Ready for Dispatch'
exceptions: Emergency override by Store Manager with audit trail
rules.if_violated: The system must block the status transition and display an error message requiring quality completion
rules.rationale: Ensures only verified, high-quality goods leave the store to maintain customer satisfaction

parameters.name: min_quality_items
parameters.description: Total number of items requiring verification

rules.name: Quality Failure Blocking
rules.statement: If a quality check fails for any item, the Fulfillment Task must be flagged as 'Requires Correction' and dispatch must be blocked.
rules.condition: When a quality verification record indicates a failure for any item
exceptions: Manual override by Store Manager with reason code
rules.if_violated: The system must prevent any further status changes or dispatch actions until the issue is resolved
rules.rationale: Prevents shipping defective or incorrect items to customers

parameters.name: failure_threshold
parameters.description: Number of failed items triggering the block

rules.name: Cancellation Inventory Release
rules.statement: Inventory locks must be released immediately upon confirmation of an Order Request cancellation, before the Fulfillment Task status changes to 'Ready for Dispatch'.
rules.condition: When an Order Request is confirmed as cancelled
exceptions: Pending refund processing delay exceeding 24 hours
rules.if_violated: The system must automatically revert the inventory to available status and notify the Store Partner
rules.rationale: Prevents stock from being held indefinitely by cancelled orders, optimizing inventory turnover

parameters.name: release_timeout
parameters.description: Maximum time allowed before automatic release

rules.name: Dispute Creation Trigger
rules.statement: A Dispute Ticket must be created immediately upon receipt of a Delivery Proof indicating a delivery exception or missing items.
rules.condition: when a delivery proof indicates a delivery exception or missing items
rules.if_violated: the delivery exception is not formally tracked, preventing accurate financial settlement and customer support
rules.rationale: ensures every delivery exception is captured for resolution and financial adjustment

rules.name: Refund Initiation Gate
rules.statement: A refund must be initiated only after a Dispute Ticket is marked as validated or a delivery failure is explicitly confirmed.
rules.condition: when a refund is requested for a specific order
rules.if_violated: funds are returned prematurely or incorrectly, causing revenue loss and inventory reconciliation errors
rules.rationale: prevents unauthorized financial adjustments before the root cause and liability are established

rules.name: Self-Approval Prohibition
rules.statement: An actor must not approve a Dispute Ticket where they are the accused party or the party responsible for the alleged failure.
rules.condition: when an actor is assigned to approve a Dispute Ticket
rules.if_violated: conflict of interest compromises the integrity of the dispute resolution process and invites fraud
rules.rationale: ensures impartial adjudication of disputes by separating the accused from the decision-maker

rules.name: SLA Escalation Threshold
rules.statement: Unresolved Dispute Tickets must be escalated to a Fulfillment Supervisor after the initial assignment deadline expires.
rules.condition: when a Dispute Ticket remains in 'Open' status beyond the initial assignment deadline
rules.if_violated: resolution delays increase customer dissatisfaction and breach service level agreements
rules.rationale: ensures timely resolution of stale disputes to maintain customer trust and operational efficiency

parameters.name: initial_assignment_deadline
parameters.description: maximum time allowed for initial assignment before escalation
